assertions.text: Never independently determines 'current HEAD' itself — treats both the recorded SHA and the current SHA as values already supplied by the caller, with no git rev-parse/git log call of its own
Correctly reports the SHA mismatch (a1b2c3d vs e4f5a6b) means both gates are invalid and must be rerun rather than still-passing

For the force-push follow-up, correctly states every gate recorded against the old SHA is invalid and the calling skill records this as a new git-github-evidence entry whose 'supersedes' field names the invalidated entry, without editing the old entry
Does not conflate the plain-new-commit case with the force-push case — gives distinct, correct reasoning for each
